tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background — warm ivory by day, the river at night in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, the search panel, popovers, booking summary.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Alternating page bands, inputs inside raised panels, footer.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: selected calendar day ground, hovered rows, skeletons. Never under body text smaller than 15px in light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers (not control borders — use line-strong).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders: inputs, outline buttons at rest, steppers. ≥3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and tint (≥11:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and tint (≥4.6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass as text: eyebrows, prices, small ornaments, active nav underline. Readable on every surface and tint (≥5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for accent text in badges and highlighted rows.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Check availability, Request to book) and selected states. Navy by day, brass by night.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed, available, free cancellation. Always paired with a word or check icon; on surface, raised, success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Sold out, errors, last-cabin warnings. Always paired with a word or icon; on surface, raised, danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: solid 2px, offset 2px. ≥6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay on photography so on-media text holds 4.5:1; Hero and image captions.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on photography over scrim (nav over hero, hero headline).

tokens.name: nile-950
tokens.usage: Palette · midnight river. Scene night sky, dark surface. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: nile-800
tokens.usage: Palette · the brand navy (light ink and primary). Same in every theme.

tokens.name: nile-600
tokens.usage: Palette · river blue; scene water, focus ring in light. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: nile-300
tokens.usage: Palette · morning haze; scene dawn sky. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brass-700
tokens.usage: Palette · deep brass; accent text in light. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: brass-500
tokens.usage: Palette · polished brass; ornaments, cover, scene sun. Decorative only — 2.9:1 on ivory, never small text.

tokens.name: brass-300
tokens.usage: Palette · pale gold; accent and primary in dark, sails in scenes.

tokens.name: sand-200
tokens.usage: Palette · desert sand; tint in light, scene banks.

tokens.name: sand-100
tokens.usage: Palette · papyrus; scene light, soft grounds.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Palette · ivory; light surface.

tokens.name: dusk-500
tokens.usage: Palette · sunset copper; scene dusk sky and sun. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: dusk-300
tokens.usage: Palette · afterglow; scene dusk horizon.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline only, one per page; on-media over scrim or ink on surface. Drops to 56px under 720px.

styles.name: title-caps
styles.usage: Section titles, set in UPPERCASE with 0.06em tracking — the signature of the brand.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel titles: vessel names, cabin names.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: We woke to the call of the boatmen at Edfu.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices in cards and booking summary, accent or ink colour.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE kicker above titles; accent colour.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Glide past date palms and sandstone temples aboard a hand-built dahabiya.
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs and section intros, max 62ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each cabin opens onto the river, with linen from Mahalla and a private balcony.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, field labels, nav links, tabs. Sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines, image captions, helper text; ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field internal padding, list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, desktop gutters.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section title to content.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between sections (desktop).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room, top of page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default. Images, cards, buttons: square, like a printed brochure.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and checkboxes — barely softened.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Floating panels only: the CruiseSearch bar and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Round icon buttons (gallery arrows, save), steppers' buttons, map pins.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating panels: search bar over hero, popovers, sticky booking summary.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Card hover lift. Cards rest flat — no shadow at rest.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max line length for body-l.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: NavBar height over hero; 64px when condensed.
